def test_new_command_skips_offset_with_live_admin_internal_port(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """Port offset avoids the derived admin internal port too."""
    from pilot.commands.bench.create import NewCommand
    from pilot.core.bench.creator import BenchCreator

    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.input", lambda _: "")
    # 7001 is admin.port(7000) + 1 at offset 0 - without the internal-port
    # check, offset 0 would be wrongly accepted since nothing else probes it.
    # (It also collides with the plain admin.port base check one offset later,
    # at offset 1, which is why the picker lands on offset 2, not 1.)
    monkeypatch.setattr(BenchCreator, "_port_is_live", staticmethod(lambda port: port == 7001))

    target = tmp_path / "benches" / "my-bench"
    NewCommand(target_directory=target, bench_name="my-bench").run()

    with open(target / "bench.toml", "rb") as f:
        data = tomllib.load(f)
    # The concrete regression guard: offset 0 (http_port 8000) must not be
    # chosen, since its admin.internal_port (7001) is already live.
    assert data["bench"]["http_port"] == 8002

def _commit_ahead_of_head(repo: Path) -> str:
    """Commit on top of the repo's HEAD, left unchecked-out - what a release
    advertises once the app has been running an older commit."""
    import subprocess

    from pilot.internal.git import GitRepo

    def git(*args: str) -> None:
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], check=True, capture_output=True)

    git("config", "user.email", "t@t.com")
    git("config", "user.name", "t")
    git("commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "installed")
    head = GitRepo(repo).head_sha
    git("commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "published")
    published = GitRepo(repo).head_sha
    git("reset", "--hard", "-q", head)
    return published

def test_unmount_legacy_bind_mount_unmounts_and_cleans_fstab(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """A leftover ZFS-era bind mount must be unmounted and its fstab line
    dropped, without depending on any ZFS/volume code being present."""
    from pilot.managers.platform import unmount_legacy_bind_mount

    target = tmp_path / "old-bench"
    target.mkdir()
    fstab = tmp_path / "fstab"
    fstab.write_text(f"UUID=abc / ext4 defaults 0 1\n/bench-pool/old-bench {target} none bind,nofail 0 0\n")

    calls: list[list[str]] = []

    def fake_run(args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(args)
        if args[:2] == ["sudo", "tee"]:
            fstab.write_bytes(kwargs["input"])
        return MagicMock(returncode=0)

    with (
        patch("subprocess.run", side_effect=fake_run),
        patch.object(Path, "is_mount", return_value=True),
    ):
        unmount_legacy_bind_mount(target, fstab_path=fstab)

    assert ["sudo", "umount", "-l", str(target)] in calls
    assert fstab.read_text() == "UUID=abc / ext4 defaults 0 1\n"

import json

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from pilot.core.app.node_packages import NodePackages
from pilot.exceptions import BenchError, CommandError


@pytest.fixture
def run_command() -> Iterator[MagicMock]:
    with (
        patch("pilot.core.app.node_packages.shutil.which", side_effect=lambda name: name),
        patch("pilot.core.app.node_packages.run_command") as run_command,
    ):
        yield run_command


# Modeled on Suite's lockfile: pnpm 12 writes its own environment as a first YAML document.
SUITE_PNPM_LOCK = """---
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

importers:

  .:
    packageManagerDependencies:
      pnpm:
        specifier: 12.10.1
        version: 12.10.1

packages:

  pnpm@12.10.1:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-abc}

---
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

importers:

  .:
    dependencies:
      vue:
        specifier: ^3.5.38
        version: 3.5.39

  frontend:
    dependencies:
      frappe-ui:
        specifier: ^0.1.0
        version: 0.1.0

packages:

  vue@3.5.39:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-def}
"""


def write_package(path: Path, **package: object) -> Path:
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "package.json").write_text(json.dumps(package))
    return path


def test_yarn_lock_installs_frozen_with_yarn(tmp_path: Path, run_command: MagicMock) -> None:
    app = write_package(tmp_path / "app")
    (app / "yarn.lock").write_text("")

    NodePackages(app).install()

    run_command.assert_called_once_with(["yarn", "install", "--frozen-lockfile"], cwd=app, stream_output=True)


def test_pnpm_lock_installs_frozen_with_pnpm(tmp_path: Path, run_command: MagicMock) -> None:
    app = write_package(tmp_path / "app")
    (app / "pnpm-lock.yaml").write_text("")

    NodePackages(app).install()

    run_command.assert_called_once_with(
        ["pnpm", "install", "--frozen-lockfile", "--config.confirmModulesPurge=false"],
        cwd=app,
        stream_output=True,
    )


def test_workspace_member_installs_from_the_workspace_root(tmp_path: Path, run_command: MagicMock) -> None:
    app = write_package(tmp_path / "app")
    (app / "pnpm-lock.yaml").write_text(SUITE_PNPM_LOCK)
    frontend = write_package(app / "frontend", scripts={"build": "vite build"})

    packages = NodePackages(frontend, app)
    packages.install()

    assert run_command.call_args.args[0][0] == "pnpm"
    assert run_command.call_args.kwargs["cwd"] == app
    assert packages.get_script_command("build") == ["pnpm", "run", "build"]


def test_member_of_a_plain_app_installs_in_its_own_directory(tmp_path: Path, run_command: MagicMock) -> None:

    frontend = write_package(app / "frontend")

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("lockfile", "marker"), [("yarn.lock", ".yarn-integrity"), ("pnpm-lock.yaml", ".modules.yaml")]

def test_install_runs_again_only_after_the_lockfile_changes(
    tmp_path: Path, run_command: MagicMock, lockfile: str, marker: str

    app = write_package(tmp_path / "app")
    (app / lockfile).write_text("")
    (app / "node_modules").mkdir()

    (app / "pnpm-lock.yaml").write_text("")
    commands: list[list[str]] = []

    def run(argv: list[str], **kwargs: object) -> None:
        commands.append(argv)
        if argv[:3] == ["npm", "install", "-g"]:
            prefix = Path(argv[argv.index("--prefix") + 1])
            (prefix / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)

    with (
        patch("pilot.core.app.node_packages.shutil.which", return_value=None),
        patch("pilot.core.app.node_packages.run_command", side_effect=run),
    ):
        NodePackages(app).install()

    local = tmp_path / "home" / ".local"
    assert commands == [
        ["npm", "install", "-g", "pnpm", "--prefix", str(local)],
        [str(local / "bin" / "pnpm"), "install", "--frozen-lockfile", "--config.confirmModulesPurge=false"],
    ]

    (app / "pnpm-lock.yaml").write_text(SUITE_PNPM_LOCK)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "workspaces",
    [["frontend"], {"packages": ["./frontend/"]}, ["*", "!./roster"]],

def test_package_json_workspaces_decide_which_folders_install_from_the_root(
    tmp_path: Path, run_command: MagicMock, workspaces: object

    app = write_package(tmp_path / "app", workspaces=workspaces)

    NodePackages(frontend, app).install()
    NodePackages(roster, app).install()

    assert [call.kwargs["cwd"] for call in run_command.call_args_list] == [app, roster]

    run_command.assert_called_once_with(["yarn", "install", "--frozen-lockfile"], cwd=app, stream_output=True)

from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import io
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import pytest

from pilot.core.site.restore import BackupRun, BackupStream, SiteRestore, backup_part
from pilot.exceptions import BenchError


def _frappe_archive(tmp_path: Path, site: str, part: str) -> Path:
    """Built the way Frappe's backup builds it: `tar cf` of ./<site>/<part>/files from sites/."""
    sites = tmp_path / "source-sites"
    (sites / site / part / "files").mkdir(parents=True)
    (sites / site / part / "files" / "logo.png").write_text("image")
    archive = tmp_path / f"20261004_010000-{site}-{'private-' if part == 'private' else ''}files.tar"
    subprocess.run(["tar", "-cf", str(archive), f"./{site}/{part}/files"], cwd=sites, check=True)
    return archive


def _site(tmp_path: Path) -> MagicMock:
    site = MagicMock()
    site.path = tmp_path / "target"
    site.path.mkdir()
    site.config.name = "target.localhost"
    return site


def test_backup_parts_are_told_apart_by_name() -> None:
    names = {
        "x-database.sql.gz": "database",
        "x-files.tar": "public",
        "x-private-files.tgz": "private",
        "x-site_config_backup.json": "config",
        "notes.txt": None,
    }
    assert {name: backup_part(name) for name in names} == names


def test_files_from_another_site_land_in_this_site(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    site = _site(tmp_path)
    run = BackupRun.from_paths([_frappe_archive(tmp_path, "source.localhost", "public")])

    SiteRestore(site).restore(run, ["public"], on_progress=lambda message: None)

    assert (site.path / "public" / "files" / "logo.png").read_text() == "image"
    site.restore.assert_not_called()  # files only: the database is left alone
    site.migrate.assert_called_once()
    assert site.set_maintenance_mode.call_args_list[-1].args == (False,)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("is_compressed", [False, True])
def test_a_streamed_archive_lands_in_this_site_without_a_copy_on_disk(tmp_path: Path, is_compressed: bool) -> None:
    site = _site(tmp_path)
    archive = _frappe_archive(tmp_path, "source.localhost", "public")
    data = gzip.compress(archive.read_bytes()) if is_compressed else archive.read_bytes()
    name = archive.name.replace(".tar", ".tgz") if is_compressed else archive.name
    run = BackupRun(streams={"public": BackupStream(name, lambda: io.BytesIO(data))})

    SiteRestore(site).restore(run, ["public"], on_progress=lambda message: None)

    assert (site.path / "public" / "files" / "logo.png").read_text() == "image"


def test_a_streamed_extraction_with_much_error_output_does_not_hang(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    """tar that writes more to stderr than a pipe holds must still read the whole archive."""
    import threading

    real_popen = subprocess.Popen
    noisy_tar = ["sh", "-c", "head -c 300000 /dev/zero | tr '\\0' e >&2; cat > /dev/null; exit 2"]
    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "Popen", lambda argv, **options: real_popen(noisy_tar, **options))
    stream = BackupStream("x-files.tar", lambda: io.BytesIO(b"x" * 1_000_000))
    errors: list[BaseException] = []

    def extract() -> None:
        try:
            SiteRestore(_site(tmp_path)).extract_files_stream(stream, "public")
        except BenchError as error:
            errors.append(error)

    worker = threading.Thread(target=extract, daemon=True)
    worker.start()
    worker.join(timeout=20)

    assert not worker.is_alive()
    assert len(errors) == 1 and "eee" in str(errors[0])
    assert len(str(errors[0])) < 5000  # only the end of the error output


def test_a_failed_file_stream_stops_the_restore_before_the_database(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    site = _site(tmp_path)
    archive = _frappe_archive(tmp_path, "source.localhost", "public")

    def broken_download() -> io.BytesIO:
        raise OSError("connection reset")

    run = BackupRun(files={"database": archive}, streams={"public": BackupStream(archive.name, broken_download)})

    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="connection reset"):
        SiteRestore(site).restore(run, ["public", "database"], lambda message: None)

    site.restore.assert_not_called()


def _source_config(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    config = tmp_path / "20261004_010000-source-site_config_backup.json"
    source_config = {
        "encryption_key": "source-key",

        "db_name": "_source",

def test_a_restored_database_brings_its_apps_and_only_the_encryption_key_of_the_config(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    site = _site(tmp_path)
    config = _source_config(tmp_path)
    database = tmp_path / "20261004_010000-source-database.sql.gz"
    database.write_bytes(b"")

    with patch("pilot.core.site.config.query_installed_apps_via_db", return_value=["frappe", "payments"]):

    site = _site(tmp_path)
    database = tmp_path / "20261004_010000-source-database.sql.gz"
    database.write_bytes(b"")

    with patch("pilot.core.site.config.query_installed_apps_via_db", return_value=None):

    assert site.set_config_values.call_args_list[-1].args == ({"encryption_key": "source-key", "max_file_size": 50},)

    site = _site(tmp_path)

    SiteRestore(site).restore(

    )

def test_a_failed_restore_keeps_the_site_in_maintenance(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    site = _site(tmp_path)
    site.migrate.side_effect = BenchError("patch failed")
    messages: list[str] = []
    run = BackupRun.from_paths([_frappe_archive(tmp_path, "source.localhost", "public")])

    with pytest.raises(BenchError, match="patch failed"):
        SiteRestore(site).restore(run, ["public"], messages.append)

    assert site.set_maintenance_mode.call_args_list[-1].args == (True,)
    assert "maintenance mode" in messages[-1]

    site = _site(tmp_path)

    with pytest.raises(BenchError, match="no private file"):

def test_a_dump_streams_into_the_client(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    from pilot.managers.database import mariadb as module

    output = tmp_path / "imported.sql"
    manager = module.MariaDBManager.__new__(module.MariaDBManager)

"""Tests for PythonAssetBuilder."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import pytest

from pilot.exceptions import BenchError
from pilot.managers.python_assets import PythonAssetBuilder


def make_app(app_path: Path, name: str = "gameplan") -> MagicMock:
    app = MagicMock()
    app.path = app_path
    app.config.name = name
    return app


def make_builder() -> PythonAssetBuilder:
    manager = MagicMock()
    return PythonAssetBuilder(manager)


def build_app(app_path: Path, on_install: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> list[list[str]]:
    """Build `app_path` from source; return every command it ran, installs included."""
    manager = MagicMock()
    manager.bench.frappe_call = ["python"]
    manager.bench.sites_path = app_path.parent / "sites"
    builder = PythonAssetBuilder(manager)
    commands: list[list[str]] = []

    def record(argv: list[str], **kwargs: object) -> None:
        commands.append(argv)

    def install(argv: list[str], **kwargs: object) -> None:
        record(argv)
        on_install()

    with (
        patch("pilot.core.app.node_packages.shutil.which", side_effect=lambda name: name),
        patch("pilot.core.app.node_packages.run_command", side_effect=install),
        patch.object(builder, "run_compiler", side_effect=record),
    ):
        app = make_app(app_path, app_path.name)
        app.has_source_changes = True
        builder.build_assets_for_app(app)
    return commands


def write_package(path: Path, **package: object) -> None:
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "package.json").write_text(json.dumps(package))


def test_frontend_dependencies_install_before_frappe_build_runs(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """frappe's own `bench build` step runs the app's build script, which builds `frontend`,
    so node_modules there must be synced before that step."""
    app_path = tmp_path / "gameplan"
    write_package(app_path / "frontend")
    (app_path / "frontend" / "yarn.lock").write_text("")

    commands = build_app(app_path)

    assert commands.index(["yarn", "install", "--frozen-lockfile"]) < commands.index(
        ["python", "frappe", "build", "--force", "--app", "gameplan"]
    )


def test_pnpm_workspace_installs_once_and_builds_once(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    app_path = tmp_path / "suite"
    write_package(app_path, scripts={"build": "pnpm --filter frontend build"})
    (app_path / "pnpm-lock.yaml").write_text("importers:\n\n  .: {}\n\n  frontend: {}\n")
    write_package(app_path / "frontend", scripts={"build": "vite build"})

    def write_install_marker() -> None:
        (app_path / "node_modules").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (app_path / "node_modules" / ".modules.yaml").write_text("")

    commands = build_app(app_path, on_install=write_install_marker)

    assert commands == [
        ["pnpm", "install", "--frozen-lockfile", "--config.confirmModulesPurge=false"],
        ["python", "frappe", "build", "--force", "--app", "suite"],
    ]


def test_frontend_builds_after_frappe_build_when_the_app_has_no_build_script(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    app_path = tmp_path / "helpdesk"
    write_package(app_path)
    write_package(app_path / "frontend", scripts={"build": "vite build"})
    (app_path / "frontend" / "pnpm-lock.yaml").write_text("")

    commands = build_app(app_path)

    assert commands[-1] == ["pnpm", "run", "build"]


def test_frontend_with_two_lockfiles_fails_before_any_install(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    app_path = tmp_path / "helpdesk"
    write_package(app_path)

    write_package(app_path / "frontend")

    with pytest.raises(BenchError, match=r"yarn\.lock and pnpm-lock\.yaml"):

def test_page_islands_are_built_with_frappe_s_own_script(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    manager = MagicMock()
    manager.bench.apps_path = tmp_path / "apps"
    builder = PythonAssetBuilder(manager)
    script = tmp_path / "apps" / "frappe" / "ui" / "vite" / "island" / "build-pages.js"

    with (
        patch.object(builder, "run_compiler") as compile_islands,
        patch("pilot.managers.python_assets.NodePackages"),
    ):
        builder.build_page_islands()
        compile_islands.assert_not_called()  # version-16 has no page islands

        script.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        script.write_text("")
        builder.build_page_islands()

    assert compile_islands.call_args.args[0] == ["node", str(script), "--production"]


def test_a_declared_build_dir_gets_its_dependencies_when_only_the_root_has_them(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Helpdesk installs `desk` from a root postinstall, so an installed root hides a missing `desk`."""
    app_path = tmp_path / "helpdesk"
    write_package(app_path, scripts={"postinstall": "cd desk && yarn install", "build": "cd desk && yarn build"})
    (app_path / "yarn.lock").write_text("")
    (app_path / "node_modules").mkdir()
    (app_path / "node_modules" / ".yarn-integrity").write_text("")
    write_package(app_path / "desk", scripts={"build": "vite build"})
    (app_path / "desk" / "yarn.lock").write_text("")
    (app_path / "pyproject.toml").write_text('[tool.bench.assets]\nbuild_dir = "./desk"\nout_dir = "./helpdesk/public/desk"\n')

    commands = build_app(app_path)

    assert commands == [
        ["yarn", "install", "--frozen-lockfile"],
        ["python", "frappe", "build", "--force", "--app", "helpdesk"],
    ]
